metadata.quantum_depth_rationale: The task accepts structured FermionicOp labels, but correctness is mainly input normalization to existing fermionic operator content.

task.problem_statement: FermionicOp currently accepts string-based labels, which works for hand-written operators but is awkward for code that generates fermionic operators programmatically. Users need to be able to construct FermionicOp terms from structured action/index label data without first formatting those labels as strings, while preserving the existing string-label behavior.
requirements: FermionicOp construction must accept terms whose labels are lists of action/index tuples.
Each tuple-based label element must use an action string such as + or - together with an integer fermionic mode index.
Tuple-based labels must produce the same dense and sparse operator content as equivalent string-based labels.
Register length must continue to be respected when tuple-based labels are supplied.
Existing FermionicOp initialization from dense labels, sparse string labels, multiple terms, scalar coefficients, and register length inference must remain compatible.

interface.Name: FermionicOp
interface.Description: Constructs a fermionic second-quantized operator from string labels or from list-of-tuple labels paired with coefficients.

interface.Name: FermionicOp.to_list
interface.Description: Returns the operator contents using the requested display format after any supported label input form has been normalized.

interface.Name: FermionicOp.register_length
interface.Description: Returns the register length used for dense conversion and operator storage.
